MCPServerConfig.description:
Configuration for connecting to an MCP server.

Two either-or modes, resolved at execute time from the wiring:
- EXTERNAL: ``server_url`` set, no bottom-wired providers — discovers and
  proxies the external server's tools (the original behavior).
- HOSTING: tool-provider nodes wired into the bottom handle, no
  ``server_url`` — aggregates their allowlisted operations into one named
  tool bundle (and optionally serves it externally via a hosted link).

server_url.description: URL of an external MCP server endpoint. Leave empty when hosting: wire tool nodes into the bottom handle instead.
server_url.title: Server URL

transport_type.description: MCP transport protocol (shttp for Streamable HTTP, sse for Server-Sent Events)
transport_type.title: Transport Type

tool_prefix.description: Prefix to add to all tool names from this server (helps avoid name conflicts)
tool_prefix.title: Tool Prefix

tool_filter.description: List of tool names to include (empty = include all tools)
tool_filter.title: Tool Filter

MCPServerConfig.title: MCPServerConfig

MCPServerCredentials.description:
Credentials for authenticating with MCP servers.

Supports both API key and OAuth authentication. For OAuth, the access_token
is fetched from the stored credential and passed at execution time.

auth_type.description: Authentication type: none, api_key, or oauth
auth_type.title: Authentication Type

api_key.description: API key for authenticating with the MCP server
api_key.title: API Key

custom_headers.description: Additional HTTP headers to send with MCP requests
custom_headers.title: Custom Headers

oauth_credential_id.description: ID of the stored OAuth credential
oauth_credential_id.title: OAuth Credential ID

oauth_server_url.description: The MCP server URL this OAuth credential is for
oauth_server_url.title: OAuth Server URL

access_token.description: OAuth access token (populated at execution time)
access_token.title: Access Token
